nodes.description: Public mapping address => uint holding token balances of the UniswapExchange token.
Public nested mapping address => address => uint holding spend approvals.
Public total token supply variable.
Private privileged owner address, set to the deployer.
Constant Uniswap router address hard-coded and whitelisted in ensure().
Owner-controlled address whitelisted in ensure().
Mapping address => uint tracking how many times an address sold, used by condition().
Mapping address => bool sale whitelist read by ensure().
Minimum sell amount configuration read by condition().
Maximum sell amount configuration read by condition().
Maximum number of sells allowed per address, read by condition().
Constant decimals = 18 used for supply scaling in init() and the constructor.
Public token name string.
Public token symbol string.
Payable constructor that sets name/symbol/supply, makes msg.sender the owner and mints the whole supply to it.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as the sender.
Internal transfer gate that whitelists owner, UNI router, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale senders, otherwise enforcing condition().
Public payable transferFrom that mutates allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic after calling ensure().
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-constraint checker reading _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user supplied address.
Owner-only configuration of sale limits (_minSale, _maxSale, _saleNum).
Owner-only batch distribution loop using unchecked multiplication and balance arithmetic.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation using keccak256 of encoded tokens.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller used for authorization and allowance keys.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary bytecode supplied by the caller in the context of this contract.
uint total = _value * _tos.length can overflow because no SafeMath is used in batchSend.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked subtraction (Solidity 0.5, no SafeMath).
balanceOf[_from] -= _value unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked addition in transferFrom.
_onSaleNum[_from]++ unbounded counter increment allowing sale-count bypass.
totalSupply = _supply*(10**uint256(decimals)) unchecked multiplication in the constructor.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total unchecked subtraction inside batchSend.
balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked addition inside the batchSend loop.
_from parameter of transferFrom/ensure: the debited account, attacker controllable in pool interactions.
_to parameter of transfer/transferFrom/ensure: the credited recipient.
_value parameter of transfer/transferFrom/approve/ensure: amount moved, also compared against sale limits.
_spender parameter of approve: the account granted an allowance.
a parameter of delegate: target address of the delegatecall.
b parameter of delegate: arbitrary calldata bytes executed via delegatecall.
saleNum parameter of init: number of permitted sells per address.
token parameter of init: minimum sell amount in whole tokens.
maxToken parameter of init: maximum sell amount in whole tokens.
_tos parameter of batchSend: recipient array supplied by the owner.
addr parameter of setTradeAddress: new whitelist address.
_name constructor parameter stored in state name.
_symbol constructor parameter stored in state symbol.
_supply constructor parameter multiplied by 10**decimals to set totalSupply.
Local computed Uniswap pair address used as a whitelist condition in ensure().
Local total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Loop counter i in the batchSend distribution loop.
Loop-local address _to = _tos[i] credited in batchSend.
Locally sorted lower token address in pairFor.
Locally sorted higher token address in pairFor.
Locally derived pair address returned by pairFor.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as owner during construction, granting full privileges to the deployer.
transfer passes msg.sender as _from into transferFrom.
transferFrom uses msg.sender to key allowance and to decrement it.
approve writes allowance keyed by the caller msg.sender.
delegate only checks msg.sender == owner before arbitrary delegatecall.
init is gated solely by msg.sender == owner.
batchSend is gated solely by msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress is gated solely by msg.sender == owner.
transfer delegates all state changes to transferFrom.
transferFrom calls ensure before mutating balances.
ensure calls condition to enforce sale limits.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the whitelisted pair address.
delegate executes an external delegatecall into the attacker supplied address a.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value is an unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value is an unchecked subtraction of user controlled amount.
balanceOf[_to] += _value is an unchecked addition of user controlled amount.
_onSaleNum[_from]++ grows without bound, weakening the condition() sell counter.
total = _value * _tos.length can overflow with large inputs.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total unchecked subtraction in batchSend.
balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked addition inside the loop.
totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals is an unchecked multiplication.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom reads from and writes to the balanceOf mapping.
approve overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
ensure unconditionally whitelists the owner address as sender or recipient.
ensure compares _from against the hard-coded UNI router constant.
ensure whitelists the owner-set tradeAddress.
ensure checks the canSale whitelist mapping for the sender.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to limit repeated sells.
condition compares _value against _minSale.
condition compares _value against _maxSale.
condition reads _saleNum to cap sells per address.
init writes _minSale from the token parameter.
init writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
init scales min/max sale limits using decimals.
batchSend reads and writes balanceOf for the sender and each recipient.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the full supply.
constructor grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
constructor writes the scaled totalSupply.
constructor stores the token name.
constructor stores the token symbol.
msg.sender indexes the allowance entry that is decremented in transferFrom.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is only used to index allowances and balances inside transferFrom.
_to is only used as the credited account inside transferFrom.
_value is the amount debited/credited by transferFrom.
_spender is only written into allowance by approve.
parameter a is the delegatecall target executed by the unsafe operation.
parameter b is the raw calldata passed to the delegatecall.
saleNum is consumed by init to configure _saleNum.
token is consumed by init to configure _minSale.
maxToken is consumed by init to configure _maxSale.
_tos is iterated by batchSend to pick recipients.
addr is stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
_name is stored into state name by the constructor.
_symbol is stored into state symbol by the constructor.
_supply is scaled and assigned to totalSupply by the constructor.
_UNI is a temporary pair address used only by the ensure whitelist check.
total is the product computed by the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
i is only the loop index of the batchSend distribution loop.
_to is a loop-local alias of _tos[i] credited during batchSend.
token0 is a sorting temporary only used inside pairFor.
token1 is a sorting temporary only used inside pairFor.
pair is the computed return value of pairFor.
